Book correction: The book prints the left side as \frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 - x}}. That expression equals \sqrt{1 - x} \approx 1 - \frac{1}{2}x, so it cannot be \approx 1 - \frac{3}{2}x. The printed result is correct for \frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 + x}}, which is what we proved.
Book correction: The book prints the right side as \frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{284}x. The correct result is \frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{384}x, since \frac{1}{4} \times \frac{17}{96} = \frac{17}{384}.
